content:
One of the best AI transcription apps on Mac has just received a major update, featuring a redesigned transcription editor and significant performance improvements. Here are the details.

MacWhisper 14 officially launched

If you're not very familiar with MacWhisper, it's an excellent application developed by prolific indie developer Jordi Bruin.

It allows users to quickly and easily transcribe audio, video, meetings, and system audio directly on Mac using locally-run AI models, including OpenAI's Whisper and Nvidia's blazing-fast Parakeet.

I use it daily in both the pre- and post-production workflow of my podcast, and I can't praise it enough.

Since MacWhisper launched in 2023, Bruin has continuously expanded its features, streamlined workflows, and delivered numerous delightful performance improvements.

MacWhisper 14 continues this direction, bringing a completely redesigned editor, faster performance, and various other tweaks.

Here's Bruin's take on this update:

Bruin says that based on initial user feedback, MacWhisper 14.1 has been quickly released, fixing several issues with the new editor and making optimizations. Version 14.1 also adds Gladia as a cloud transcription service provider, allowing users to transcribe using their own Gladia API key.

MacWhisper 14 also includes the following:

Redesigned AI services screen that's clearer and easier to use; AI models from major popular providers have been updated; Better playback when handling multiple open transcription files simultaneously; Improved transcription window, including smoother Cmd+A operation and real-time editing interactions; Enhanced Deepgram features, including EU/US region selection, filler word control, and expanded language support for Nova 3; No longer need to load entire files into memory when uploading for cloud transcription; Fixed issues with menu bar position, audio/video scrubber sync, CPU usage when idle, and edge cases in meeting recording

MacWhisper Pro users can upgrade to version 14 for free. Bruin is also currently offering a 14% discount for users interested in upgrading to Pro.
